heldout_ce_reference_gsm8k_subset.note: 4-prompt preregistered held-out subset; CE only (NOT exact-match). The 10-step run is single-batch -> SMOKE, not a utility claim.
heldout_ce_reference_gsm8k_subset.interpretation: 10-step single-batch protected training slightly overfits the batch; held-out CE ~unchanged/slightly up. Confirms this is a systems smoke, not converged utility.

utility_claim_basis: L10 == L1 by construction: O1-C is exact-parameter-equivalent to plaintext SGD/momentum/AdamW (fp64 matrix, worst 3.8e-13) -> identical trained model -> identical utility.
Protected deployability is demonstrated (package-native, zero plaintext materializations).
